texts.preamble: Yougender Swamy vs The State Of Telangana And 4 Others on 16 February, 2022
texts.facts: 4. The detaining authority resorted to extraordinary measure of preventively detaining the detenu on the ground of involvement in four crimes and also considered the history of involvement of the detenue in two other crimes and securing bails in all the crimes. According to the detaining authority the detenu is in the habit of committing crimes, securing bail and after securing bail indulging in committing crimes.
texts.arguments: 2. This writ petition is filed by the father of detenu-Paramkusam Roshan challenging the order of detention made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land- Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act No.1 of 1986) 5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the crimes reported against the detenu are all routine law and order crimes and do not attract disturbance to public order warranting initiation of proceedings under the Act 1 of 1986 and preventively detaining the detenu. She would submit that the detenu was wrongly implicated in the crimes and on due consideration of the application to grant bail, bail was granted in all the cases and without taking steps to seek cancellation of bail, if what is alleged by the prosecution is true, the detaining authority could not have resorted to the extreme measure of preventively detaining the detenu affecting his right to life and liberty. 6. According to learned Government Pleader, as can be seen from the narration of events noticed in the order of detention, the detenu is in the habit of involving in crimes and sofar, six crimes are registered against him. He would submit that detenue committed heinous crime of murdering a driver for gain, stealing the vehicle and mobile phone. The crime was committed in a gruesome manner and if detenu is allowed to go scot-free, he may indulge in committing similar crimes, which will disturb the public order.
